data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kara' which means 'to be noble' or 'exalted'. This name is used to describe someone of high character and moral integrity. The name Kaarima carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaarima usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
